usedFor: DitCal holds the bookings and Razorpay collects the money, so “New Booking” runs “Create Payment Link”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Booking” in DitCal, then “Create Payment Link” in Razorpay
bestTemplate.why: Each booking gets a shareable payment link, with amount, expiry and customer details set in the action.

watchOut: “Create Payment Link” only makes the link, so getting it to the client needs a separate step and approval.
